topic: Purpose and stages of wastewater treatment
question: What is the main purpose of treating wastewater before it is discharged?
correctAnswer: To reduce pollutants so the receiving water and public health are protected
explanation: Treatment removes or reduces contaminants so that the discharge does not harm the stream or the people who use it.
options: To add nutrients so the receiving stream can support a larger population of fish and plants
To reduce pollutants so the receiving water and public health are protected
To make the effluent safe enough to drink directly from a household tap without further handling
To increase the volume of clean water returned to the river so downstream users have more supply
optionA: To add nutrients so the receiving stream can support a larger population of fish and plants
optionB: To reduce pollutants so the receiving water and public health are protected
optionC: To make the effluent safe enough to drink directly from a household tap without further handling
optionD: To increase the volume of clean water returned to the river so downstream users have more supply
